quotes.text: Great company, locally owned and operated by a class act. I felt safe and in great hands the whole time. Chris is very knowledgeable about Austin and the airplane is actually very comfortable. We had a terrific tour of Tesla Gigafactory and Downtown Austin and we could see so much! Listening to the radio communication with the tower is pretty fun, too. This is a cool way to explore Austin and to get an aerial perspective is really the way to go. Top notch!

My daughter and I took a flight with Chris, and top-to-bottom, the experience was awesome. The plane gives both a vintage and a modern feel simultaneously with things like noise-canceling headsets. Chris was able to patiently and comically answer all of my questions, which included as many questions about the plane itself as the scenery all around. I look forward to taking another tour soon!

This could not have been a more perfect or memorable experience to celebrate an anniversary in a new city! Chris and Pedro are both top-notch pilots and just overall great guys. We would 100% do this again!!
